linkedin:
Your remote job application is competing with dozens of others. Here's how to make yours stand out.

Lead with the exact job title and where you saw it. Then, in one sentence, explain why your recent work fits the team. Save your life story for later.

Show proof of async work: mention a project you ran with written updates, a shared document you owned, or a time zone gap you handled well.

Match their words. If they say 'customer support', don't write 'client care'. Hiring software and tired humans look for the same words.

Keep your CV short: one clean page. Put recent remote or freelance work first, with what you shipped.

Follow up once, politely, after a week. One note restates your fit. More reads as pressure.

For more tips, visit http://fixtures:8000/no-numbers-post.md
